Maya Patel: Heads-up  AWS/GCP/Azure onboarding intake landed. Need final SKU CSV, short descriptions, AMIs/GCR URIs, legal attachments and feature-entitlement map by EOW. Can we split owners?
Luis Fernandez: I can own SKU CSV + pricing matrix. Proposal: Standard (monthly + preview-hourly), Dedicated (monthly commit), Support addon. Keep SKU IDs short.
Aisha Khan: Legal  will prepare EULA excerpt, DPA pointer and export control note. Also need to know which features persist customer data (KV cache, logs).
Tom Everett: Infra note  AMI bake scheduled tonight. I'll push public AMI for Standard and account-locked AMI for Dedicated. GCR/ACR images done once CI passes.
Maya Patel: For marketplace PM, we should include a one-page differences summary across clouds (billing cadence, region availability, BYOL notes). Can someone draft that?
Luis Fernandez: I'll draft the differences doc and paste into the bundle. Also I'll add columns for per-1M token est cost and per-hour GPU est.
Aisha Khan: Please tag features that store data. I'll mark residency clauses accordingly. Also EU listings need FR/DE translations for short descriptions.
Tom Everett: Will add a metadata CSV with AMI IDs and image URIs. Expect manifests in s3://redwood-marketplace/listings/manifest_1829.json by tomorrow AM.
marketplace-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-marketplace/listing_assets/182900_bundle.tar.gz (sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c14...)
Maya Patel: Action items summary: Luis (SKU+pricing+diff doc), Tom (images + manifest), Aisha (EULA + DPA + EU clauses + review), Marketing to localize short descriptions (EN/FR/DE). Reconvene Thursday 9am PT to do a final pass.
Luis Fernandez: I'll start the SKU CSV now and share link.
Aisha Khan: I'll aim to have legal redlines within 48h. Flagging Azure billing cadence requirement  they often need explicit monthly vs hourly language.
Tom Everett: Noted. If packaging hits a blocker I'll post in #eng-infra and tag Maya.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. If we hit privacy or SOC questions, loop in security@redwood.ai. :shipit:
